classification.difficultyReason: Use parallel lines to identify similar triangles, then distinguish corresponding whole sides from the labelled side segments.

content.prompt: Find the value of the pronumerals.

spec.description: Unshaded triangle with a segment parallel to its bottom side. Matching single arrows point towards the left on the parallel segments. All six supplied segment labels are retained. Ordinary source-blue strokes are rendered black under house style.
spec.mathematics: The internal segment and base have lengths 1.5 and 3. The upper left and right segments have lengths 2.5 and 2; the remaining segments are b and a.
spec.answerVisibility: All supplied measurements and unknowns are visible; no answers are shown.

answer.worked:
The smaller and larger triangles are similar by AAA because the internal segment is parallel to the base. Their corresponding lengths are in the ratio $1.5:3=1:2$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{2}{2+a}&=\frac12\\2+a&=4\\a&=2\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\frac{2.5}{2.5+b}&=\frac12\\2.5+b&=5\\b&=2.5\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Unshaded triangle with an internal segment parallel to its sloping bottom side. Matching single arrows point towards the right on both parallel segments. All six supplied segment labels are retained. Ordinary source-blue strokes are rendered black under house style.
spec.mathematics: The internal segment and base have lengths 4 and 5. The left side is divided into upper segment y and lower segment 1.5; the right side into upper segment x and lower segment 0.5.
spec.answerVisibility: All supplied measurements and unknowns are visible; no answers are shown.

answer.worked:
The smaller and larger triangles are similar by AAA because the internal segment is parallel to the base. Their corresponding lengths are in the ratio $4:5$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{x+0.5}&=\frac45\\5x&=4(x+0.5)\\5x&=4x+2\\x&=2\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\frac{y}{y+1.5}&=\frac45\\5y&=4(y+1.5)\\5y&=4y+6\\y&=6\end{align*}$$
